testCases.title: Create Application (Happy Path)

preconditions.state: No application named 'Test App Delta' exists

steps: Attach an application group and roles
expectedResults: Application record created with name='Test App Delta', isActive=true
UAM Application Role rows created for the attached roles
cleanup: Soft-delete the created application and its roles

testCases.title: Map application to organization
steps: Assign 'Test App Delta' via the organization-application form
expectedResults: A UAM Organization Application row links the org and application

testCases.title: Remove application group

preconditions.state: Application with an attached group exists

expectedResults: The application group association is removed
assertions: The application's group association no longer returns rows
cleanup: Re-attach the group via pre-provisioned data reset
